changes.quote: Doc fee not to exceed $399.00. If over $225.00, dealer must comply with specific Texas regulations and show proof of compliance upon the Bank’s request.
changes.note: The record had the $399 ceiling but not the $225 trigger, which is the number that actually creates work for the desk. Also adds the out-of-state title guarantee and the TX ELT number from the funding checklist.

changes.note: A $50 charge against reserve on every GAP contract, which the record did not mention. The sales-tax line matters for the same reason — it lands on the front end and can move the buy rate.

changes.quote: Contracts 24-47 months with a total amount financed of $7,500.00 or more will receive a $100 flat.
changes.note: The record showed the rate-adjustment table as if it applied to everything. It only applies to 48+ month contracts at $10,000 or more; smaller and shorter deals get a flat $100. The chargeback rule was also only half in the record — the 25% balance-reduction trigger and the product-refund clawback were missing, and both bite after funding.

changes.quote: We will finance vehicles with up to $3,000 of unrepaired hail damage as long as the approved vehicle value is lowered by the amount of the damage.
changes.note: The vehicles section was a single ineligible list with no data rows at all. Adds the valuation fallback chain, the April 1 model-year flip, the hail-damage allowance (Fifth Third will take unrepaired hail up to $3,000 — most books will not), and the EV-charging-station exclusion.
